verses.text: husuunii hanil ahdaa-i wan naari wal balaa
sanaa-i halaa man zahzahad durra ahmadaa
midaadii wa aqlaamii lirabbii wa lin nabii
ujaarii bihaa man akhlasus sah-ya hummadaa
matii maa ahud lil madhi wash shukri khaadiman
yajud bil munaa wal hawdu maa zaala ahmadaa
duhaa-is tajib bil mustafaa rabbi sarmadan
wa minnii taqabbal rabbi mas-haaya wa ahmadaa
